movelist.name: Wake-Up Slap
movelist.effect: If the target is Asleep, Wake-Up Slap has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead, and cures the target of Sleep.

movelist.name: Fake Tears
movelist.effect: Lower the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Mean Look
movelist.effect: The user casts a foul spell on the target, causing it to become Trapped and Slowed for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Heart Stamp
movelist.effect: Heart Stamp Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Ice Punch
movelist.effect: Ice Punch Freezes the target on 19+ during Accuracy Check.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Enraged and Infatuated conditions. Defensive.

abilities.name: Weird Power
abilities.effect: If the user’s Attack is higher than its Special Attack, the user may add its Attack Stat to its Special Damage Rolls. If their Special Attack is higher, they user may add its Special Attack Stat to its Physical Damage Rolls. This does not stack with Mixed Power.
